issue: docs/surface-area-backlog.md SR8, opening the ramp sub-shape

landed_against.rule: R-17: this slice declares every diff path here and re-captures all three baselines in the same commit.

what_landed: A champion may declare a swing ramp, the same DecayingStackRamp record an item ramp is, and the walker adds a kit ramp's bonus to a build ramp's rather than one replacing the other. Jax's Relentless Assault is the first slot on it.
why: Jax opened every fight at eight stacks because the level was declared. He ramps from nothing now: 5 swings in a five-second fight against the 6 a full stack claimed, 20 against 25 over twenty seconds. Every leaf that moves is a swing count or something priced off one.
All 30 pair leaves are his. The 539 coupled leaves are one roster, cleaver_bloodsong, whose Jax swings changed and cascaded through its event ledger.

The merge is what makes this safe: refusing a build that carries both ramps broke Jax with Rageblade and the census caught it as five item-pair failures. With the walker taking both, the census is unchanged.

qualifying_population.rule: Jax is the only kit that declares a swing_ramp, and one coupled roster holds him.

/metadata/fingerprint/leaves.cause: his passive row publishes the ramp instead of a stat buff

summary.direction: down: a ramp that starts empty is worth less than one declared full

described_leaves.rule: Amendment E: each claimed disposition transition names the leaf it describes and the values on both sides. The described leaf is unchanged under compare's identity pairing, so no value question is owed; the value the index holds on each side is recorded beside it because the index, not the record, is what moved.

/coupled_scenarios/cleaver_bloodsong_ros.cause: The disposition map is keyed by position while combat/events is paired by event_id, so the four records this slice drops and the two it adds slide every later index. The event sitting at this index is a different record on each side: its own damage and overkill are unchanged under identity pairing, which is why neither leaf is in the difference set, and the disposition entry reports the record that now occupies the position.
